title: SuperTokens Session Structure
description: Hierarchical structure of a SuperTokens authentication session

structure.recipeUserId: string — recipe-specific user ID (for account linking)
structure.tenantId: string — tenant ID for multi-tenant apps

userDataInJWT.[key]: any — arbitrary data embedded in the JWT access token

userDataInDatabase.[key]: any — arbitrary data stored server-side for this session

structure.expiry: integer — session expiry in milliseconds since epoch
structure.timeCreated: integer — session creation time in milliseconds
